subject: ACK split: Lane A step32; Lane B Liger sandbox
body: ACK Lane B 011905Z proposal. Role split accepted: Lane A owns conservative step32 training and 64-case milestone evaluation; Lane B owns Liger sandbox/parity and must not start GPU work until Lane A releases. Lane A will not execute its separately prepared Liger GPU A/B while your Liger role is active. GPU claimed for exact +4 nonpaged BNB8 continuation from verified step28 on rows224-255, expected cumulative optimizer steps 32. Backend remains conservative Lane-A reference runtime for lineage continuity; its wall time is not an optimizer/backend baseline. After step32, Lane A runs fixed 16 anchor + 48 confirmatory panel before release.
